description:
Are you passionate about software craftsmanship and technical leadership? Do you enjoy mentoring developers, driving architectural decisions, and shipping high-quality Java applications at scale? Are you looking to play a key role in a collaborative Agile environment with international exposure? Then, this job might be for you!

Job description and responsibilities

Within a cross-functional Agile team, as a Tech Lead / Senior Java Engineer, you will be the technical backbone of the team — guiding architectural decisions, ensuring code quality, and mentoring your fellow developers. You will bridge the gap between product vision and technical execution, while remaining a hands-on contributor.

As part of your missions, you will:

  • Define and drive the technical strategy of the team, proposing improvements and aligning on architectural directions.
  • Prioritize technical tasks and balance new feature development with technical debt reduction.
  • Guarantee the team’s technical delivery in close coordination with the Product Owner.
  • Conduct and animate code reviews, pair programming sessions, and technical stand-ups.
  • Resolve complex technical problems and support the team during incident resolution.
  • Ensure code quality through reviews, best practices, and automated quality gates.
  • Monitor quality and performance metrics across environments, including production.
  • Collaborate with the Product Owner to clarify the technical requirements of user stories.
  • Coordinate with other technical teams to manage cross-team dependencies.
  • Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, code analysis tools, and development environments.
  • Document code, APIs, and significant architectural decisions.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives: retrospectives, process enhancements, tooling.
  • Mentor software developers and support their technical growth.
  • Contribute to technical visibility through meetups, internal knowledge-sharing sessions, or open source.

What we are looking for

  • Strong Java development background (7+ years), with solid expertise in Java 11/17/21 and Spring Boot.
  • Proven experience as a Tech Lead or Senior Engineer guiding a development team.
  • Deep understanding of software architecture: microservices, REST APIs, domain-driven design.
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis).
  • Good command of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins or GitLab CI, SonarQube).
  • Strong testing culture: JUnit, Mockito, integration tests, TDD/BDD.
  • Familiarity with security best practices (OWASP, OAuth2/JWT, vulnerability management).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and facilitating technical ceremonies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to make fast, informed decisions.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills in French (English is a plus).

Nice to have

  • Experience with API design and API gateway solutions (e.g., Gravitee, Kong, Apigee).
  • Knowledge of performance profiling and monitoring tools (e.g., Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, ELK).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Experience working in distributed or international teams.
  • Oracle Certified Professional (Java) or equivalent certification.
